title: Hair Braiding Salon
description: African Touch – Hair Braiding is a business web presentation.
development: African Touch is a website for a hair braiding business. It provides information about services, showcases hairstyles, and includes a contact form for booking appointments.
objectives: Design a Single Page Application (SPA) for a hair braiding business
Leveraging React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
Implementing a responsive and mobile-friendly design
Delivered MVP within a tight timeframe, showcasing adaptability and efficiency
Provided a user-friendly interface for clients to explore services and book appointments
Presented possible path forward for future development and enhancements, including features like booking system, payment integration, and more

title: HJ Unite
description: Web app for planning and tracking manufacturing jobs at HamiltonJet
development: HJ Unite is an internal manufacturing scheduling web app developed for HamiltonJet. I contributed as a Java contractor, modernising backend APIs, improving legacy UI with JSF/PrimeFaces, and integration with the M3 ERP system.
objectives: Enhanced backend APIs with Java 21 and Quarkus Java FW
Integration with M3 ERP for seamless data flows
Improved legacy UI for better usability
Resolved complex integration and bug issues
Streamlined scheduling and manufacturing logic
Collaborated with a project lead and CTO
Documented workflows and technical solutions
Strengthened DevOps with better build processes
Expanded skills in Docker containerisation for local development and deployment
Gained experience in large enterprise environments
Sharpened skills in Java, JSF/PrimeFaces, and troubleshooting

title: Stellar Share
description: Community sharing app with a sci-fi theme
development: This app was created in a group of 6 developers as our final group project for Dev Academy Aotearoa. It is a community item sharing / borrowing app with a fun sci-fi theme and focus on the social aspects of the community.
objectives: Project management and work coordination in a team of six
Fundamentals of Tailwind CSS and custom classes
CSS animations and transitions and other interactive effects
Using Auth0 as authentication provider
Protect parts of apps based on user roles
Managing Git workflows and pull-request reviews
Dokku deployment of full-stack applications
Practice with React and TypeScript
Conflict resolution and team communication

title: Bird Collection
description: A Web application keeping a detailed list of birds observations.
development: A two-person full-stack project. It contains node modules, SQLite database to store the bird data, routes, API requests, and React component using React Query. The app is a bird collection app that allows users to keep a detailed list of bird observations.
objectives: Implementing a full-stack application using React, TypeScript, and SQLite
Learning about React Query, a library for managing, caching, and updating asynchronous data in React applications
Creating a responsive and user-friendly interface
Learning about error handling and error boundaries
Mastering React forms, hooks and context management with React Query

title: Dog Dating App
description: FullStack single-page application for canine connections.
development: This app was created in a group of 4 developers as a part of my study at Dev Academy Aotearoa. It is a simple, single-page application that allows users to create a profile for their dog, and connect with other dog owners in their area.
objectives: Learning about React, TypeScript, and the Context API
Implementing a full-stack application using React, TypeScript, and a backend server
Learning about Knex.js – SQL query builder, Migration API (seedings, migrations)
Vitest – a test library for React
Learning about CSS preprocessor like Sass

title: Guess Country
development: This is a front end single page application. This app was created in a group of 4 developers as a part of my study at Dev Academy Aotearoa. It is a flag guessing game containing all of the worlds countries and territories.
objectives: Learning about React, TypeScript
Implementing a front-end application using React, TypeScript, and client-side APIs
Learning about react-router-dom, expres and vite servers, vitest, and eslint

title: Query 'em All App
description: Simple site that pulls pokemon info from the public Poké API
development: This app was one of the first I built as a part of my study at Dev Academy Aotearoa. It is a simple app that pulls information on all pokemon from the publicly available poke API, and displays info on each one.
objectives: Learning about React, TypeScript
Implementing a front-end application using React, TypeScript, and client-side APIs
Learning about React Query, and how to consume public APIs
Learning about loading states and error handling

title: Collection of simple API Apps
description: A site that pulls data from a number of public APIs
development: This simple site is one of the first plays with consuming clientside APIs. I created that of my study at Dev Academy Aotearoa. It is a simple app that pulls information from publicly available APIs to practice querying in React and Typescript, and displays info on each one.
objectives: Learning about React, TypeScript
Implementing a front-end application using React, TypeScript, and client-side APIs
Learning about React Query, and how to consume public APIs
Learning about loading states and error handling
